title: Synchronization Boundary
claim: The candidate serializes kernel worker/IRQ operations with a kernel mutex, but that lock does not synchronize writes performed directly through a userspace mapping of the FIFO pages.

evidence.observation: Kernel worker uses a mutex around FIFO accesses.

evidence.locator: irq_handle wrapper and ioctl lock sequence
evidence.observation: IRQ and selected ioctl paths use kernel mutexes; userspace mmap stores do not acquire these driver mutexes.
FIFO pages are mapped directly into a process address space.

inferences: Kernel-side mutex coverage cannot make mapped node metadata immutable or prevent userspace from changing it while the worker/IRQ reads it.
unknowns: Whether the intended userspace producer follows a publication protocol or uses an independent synchronization mechanism is unknown.
scope: Richtap shared FIFO used by richtap_update_fifo_data and richtap_rtp_work; offline NX809J stock evidence only.
